name: influencer.picture_set
description: Records one read of an Instagram account: the address influencer.picture_file answered for it (null when Meta showed no picture: the one kept stays) and the followers Meta counted (null: the count kept stays). Keeps only the address's path on the core. Internal.
sql:
update brandbase.influencer_accounts a set
  picture = case when a.picture_key is not null and right(:src::text, length(a.picture_key) + 1) = '/' || a.picture_key then coalesce(substring(:src::text from '/files/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}/brandbase/[0-9a-f-]{36}\.(?:jpg|png|webp)$'), a.picture) else a.picture end,
  followers = coalesce(:followers::bigint, a.followers),
  read_at = :now::timestamptz
where a.influencer_id = :id::uuid and a.platform = 'instagram' and a.handle = :handle
returning jsonb_build_object('handle', a.handle, 'picture', a.picture, 'followers', a.followers) as result
